name: text-formatting-tool
description: AI-guided deterministic text transformation tool (v2 scaffold)

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @tft/web && npm run lint -w @tft/transformation-schema && npm run lint -w @tft/transformation-engine
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tft/transformation-schema && npm run typecheck -w @tft/transformation-engine && npm run typecheck -w @tft/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tft/transformation-schema && npm run test -w @tft/transformation-engine && npm run test -w @tft/web
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run cf-build
